sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 54259 of 2023
Applicant :- Jashwant

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Om Narayan Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
The FIR in question was lodged alleging that recovery of 41 notes of Rs. 100/- denomination from the applicant which are prima facie according to the FIR are fake currency.
3. The submission of the counsel for the applicant is that recovery is not in terms of the Section 100 Cr.P.C. and applicant has no criminal antecedents and he is in custody since 17.7.2023.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

Jashwant vs State Of U.P. on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44448397/
1 5.

Considering the fact that the recovery is not in accordance with Section 100 Cr.P.C. which is not in the present of any independent witness, applicant has no criminal history and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit
, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicantJashwantbe released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 141 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 489A, 489B, 489C, 489D IPC & 63 Copy Right Act, P.S. Badgaon, District Saharanpur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs. 25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.12.2023 S.A.
